subject: Partner-led discovery 11 next steps & technical deep dive (CloudBridge)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up + next steps from today's discovery (CloudBridge)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side: CloudBridge is evaluating a marketplace integration to surface Redwood inference offerings in your catalog, with an initial focus on inference for document summarization and QA (low-latency, cost-sensitive workloads). Key constraints you called out were dedicated capacity for enterprise customers, SSO via SAML, and billing reconciliation on the marketplace side.

Proposed next step: a technical deep dive / demo with our solutions engineering and partner integrations team to align on integration touchpoints (SSO, entitlement mapping, billing tokens, and deployment options). Can you share 2-3 windows that work for your infra/marketplace team next week? We can slot in a 60-75 minute session to cover architecture and an initial run-through of the integration flow.

I've attached the discovery slides we went over and a draft NDA for legal (we can skip if not needed).

Agenda suggestion:
- 10 min intros & goals
- 20 min architecture / marketplace flow (Camila)
- 25 min demo + Q&A (David)
- 10 min next steps / mutual action plan

Available slots we can offer: Tue 12/8 10-12 PT, Wed 12/9 9-11 PT, Thu 12/10 1-4 PT. If those don't work, tell me your preferred windows and we'll align.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: Discovery_Slides_CloudBridge.pdf, CloudBridge_NDA.pdf

Thanks for the recap and slides — that captures it. Devon (cc'd) will be the technical lead on our side and should join the deep dive. The team would also like to include one person from our AWS Marketplace integrations crew to cover billing/token exchange.

From our side the best windows are:
- Wed 12/9 10:30-12:00 PT
- Thu 12/10 1:30-3:00 PT

Either of those work for us. Please confirm who will present the marketplace integration flow (we assume Camila), and if you want us to share any pre-reads (token exchange spec, billing mapping spreadsheet).

Thanks,
Alex

alex@cloudbridge.com
